title: Great bike ride, definitely do it!
text: Great bike ride with fantastic views and fun facts, so definitely do it if you are in Granada (or any other city)! You see so much of the city in 3 hours and then you also know which parts you want to go back to. Our guide was super friendly, very enthusiastic, and very skilled! The electric bikes were (apart from the saddle ;) super and it hardly took any effort to climb a steep hill. Definitely do it!
author: J6038POannekev
